harnesses.name: Health operating validate
harnesses.description: Fast Agent Operating Harness gate for doc drift, dossier consistency, and report-only backend lint.
harnesses.when_to_run: Before handoff after code, docs, dossier, or system-map changes.

harnesses.name: Health backend smoke
harnesses.description: Backend smoke tests for core API availability and request validation.
harnesses.when_to_run: After touching backend routing, auth, app startup, or smoke-covered API contracts.

harnesses.name: Health LLM regression gate
harnesses.description: Offline synthesis regression gate for invariant and health-agent-core golden suites, with live suites behind an explicit flag.
harnesses.when_to_run: After changing health agent prompts, synthesis policy, safety wording, or eval datasets.

harnesses.name: Health runtime eval
harnesses.description: Golden-set eval for health runtime behavior with baseline regression detection.
harnesses.when_to_run: After changing runtime evaluators, health runtime scoring, orchestrator outputs, or health data interpretation.

harnesses.name: Health retrieval eval
harnesses.description: Golden-set eval for health retrieval behavior and baseline drift.
harnesses.when_to_run: After changing memory injection, hybrid retrieval, knowledge graph, or retrieval guard behavior.

harnesses.name: Health memory prime
harnesses.description: Read-only selective Codex memory lookup for starting health harness work without loading the full registry.
harnesses.when_to_run: Before architecture, harness, or memory-sensitive work in health-llm-driven.

harnesses.name: Health LangBridge gateway smoke
harnesses.description: End-to-end smoke from health to the browser-llm-orchestrator OpenAI-compatible gateway.
harnesses.when_to_run: Before or after changing cross-project LangBridge routing, gateway credentials, or model exposure.
